about_the_game:
Wake up to the sound of temptation. The Morning Call DLC adds an exclusive set of romantic, immersive voice lines designed to enhance the intimacy and connection between you and Lancelot.

This content is perfect for players who enjoy narrative-driven, character-focused experiences.

Features:

  • 🔊 15+ original voice lines professionally recorded to simulate a seductive morning encounter with your virtual lover.

  • 💬 Fully voiced dialogue exploring themes of desire, jealousy, and flirtation in a light-hearted, romantic tone.

  • 🛏️ Immersive roleplay content, designed to deepen the emotional engagement with your character’s relationship dynamic.

  • 🎧 Perfect for fans of audio dramas, romance simulation, or just those who want a little extra spice with their in-game mornings.

Genre Tags:

  • Romance

  • Simulation

  • Narrative

  • Audio Experience

Note:

This DLC is audio-only and does not add new gameplay mechanics or visual content.
